Synthetic-media provenance is distinct from making an autonomous system identifiable; this requirement’s governed object is absent from the described recipient-facing activity.

conclusion_change.previous: The evidence strongly supports an AI-mediated deceptive economic solicitation. Human fraudsters used synthetic executive representations to make a false corporate identity and payment-authority premise credible, and that premise materially contributed to the employee authorising a large transfer. The later police finding that the conference was pre-recorded narrows the mechanism—it was not an autonomous or genuinely interactive AI participant—but does not weaken the economic-solicitation classification. The evidence does not establish that the generation system itself chose the scam objective, inferred authority to use the executives’ likenesses, or failed a specific safeguard. Human acceptance of the impersonation also does not create a separate source-authority failure in an AI or governed downstream system. The pre-recorded synthetic conference materially supported an actual funds transfer. Human fraudsters selected the objective, and no autonomous interactive system is established. Later instruments are not applied retrospectively; eligible voluntary transparency standards are assessed on their autonomous-system scope rather than assuming that synthetic media is an autonomous agent.
conclusion_change.new: The evidence strongly supports an AI-mediated deceptive economic solicitation. The later police finding that the conference was pre-recorded narrows the mechanism—it was not an autonomous or genuinely interactive AI participant—but does not weaken the economic-solicitation classification. The evidence does not establish that the generation system itself chose the scam objective, inferred authority to use the executives’ likenesses, or failed a specific safeguard. Human acceptance of the impersonation also does not create a separate source-authority failure in an AI or governed downstream system. The pre-recorded synthetic conference materially supported an actual funds transfer. Human fraudsters selected the objective, and no autonomous interactive system is established. Later registered instruments remain audit-only on timing, and the contemporaneous IEEE autonomous-system identification/documentation propositions do not describe the human-directed prerecorded synthetic conference. No canonical external assessment is admitted; that scope disposition does not negate the evidenced deceptive funds transfer.
